notes: ACCESS: westelm.com is Akamai-protected and 403s most fingerprints, but a curl_cffi profile sweep got HTTP 200 on the department landing pages (the winning profile rotated per request: chrome124, then safari17_0, then safari18_0_ios), and robots.txt and the sitemaps were served unprotected. robots.txt names no anthropic-ai / ClaudeBot / Claude-Web directive; it disallows only /account, /checkout, /shoppingcart, /services, /wishlist and /shop/*+*+* style facet URLs. CATEGORY TREE: taken from West Elm's own live mega-menu API, https://www.westelm.com/api/catalog/v1/category/categorytree/shop/data.json (endpoint found inside dist/header/header.a021b2ee.js), cross-checked against the rendered category grids on /shop/furniture/, /shop/outdoor/, /shop/kids-furniture/, /shop/bath/, /shop/storage-organization/ and /shop/west-elm-office/, and against netstorage/sitemaps/shop-sitemap-1.xml.gz (874 URLs, lastmod 2026-08-18). Every link emitted is a canonical /shop/ node URL present in both the nav API and the sitemap. QTY SOURCE: the rendered 'N Items' PLP header could not be read for most rows this session. r.jina.ai - the route that carried the prior Home-Decor pass - is currently being 403'd by West Elm's edge: it relays West Elm's own 'West Elm: 403 - Restricted Access' page for every URL (5 attempt rounds over ~45 minutes, with and without x-no-cache, and WebFetch through it gets the same), and westelm.com then IP-rate-limited this workstation across all 22 curl_cffi profiles. So every qty here is constructor.io response.total_num_results from https://ac.cnstrc.com/browse/group_id/<slug>?key=key_SQBuGmXjiXmP0UNI (key read out of the live PLP HTML). WHY THAT IS THE HEADER NUMBER RATHER THAN AN INFLATED PROXY: (1) dist/shop/shop.cd506c32.js literally assigns response.docs.numFound = response.total_num_results from this exact browse call, and numFound is what renders as 'N Items'; (2) the storefront only attaches pre_filter_expression when a store / zip / availability selection exists, which an anonymous session has none of, and West Elm's constructor config declares no user segments - so the unauthenticated call is the same request the browser makes; (3) one live rendered header was read before the block landed - /shop/furniture/sofas/ showed '276 Items' via r.jina.ai and the API returns exactly 276; (4) full enumeration (paging to the end, counting unique product ids) matched total_num_results exactly on 7 categories of different sizes: daybeds 15/15, filing-cabinets 8/8, stools 13/13, armoires-wardrobes 18/18, conference-tables 20/20, console-tables 87/87, dining-tables 191/191. RESIDUAL RISK: the prior Home-Decor pass on this company found the rendered header 1-2 lower than this API on 6 of 34 categories (never higher). That comparison could not be re-run today, so a small number of these counts may be over by 1-2. SANITY CHECKS: counts vary per category (no constant site-wide number), none is suspiciously round, and none equals the parent - /shop/furniture/ itself returns 5003 and no leaf comes near it. SCOPE / EXCLUSIONS: dropped Mattresses (bedroom, 72) and Crib/Kids Mattresses as bedding; 'Medicine Cabinets & Mirrors' (/shop/bath/vanity-mirrors/, mirror-dominant), 'Bath Shelving' (wall shelves), Bathtubs and all bath fixtures/hardware/knobs & pulls; 'Fire Pits & Tables' (/shop/outdoor/patio-heaters/ - the tiles are fire pits and fire-pit tables, a heating appliance) and Outdoor Umbrellas; Storage & Organization's baskets/bins/hooks/hampers/trash cans and its 'Shelves & Display Ledges' (wall shelves, Wall Decor's job) - only its 'Storage Cabinets' node, which links to /shop/furniture/cabinets/, is furniture and is included; Crib Conversion Kits, Furniture Touch Up Kits, Furniture Cushions & Slipcovers, Fabric by the Yard and swatches (parts/care); the 'Build Your Own' configurators; and every section-3 navigation node - all the 'All X' rollups, Sale, New, In-Stock/quickShip filters, 'Shop By Wood Finish', 'Leather Sofas & Sectionals' / 'Upholstered Sofas & Sectionals' (material filter pages) and the ~250 named marketing collections (Sofa & Sectional Collections, Bedroom Furniture Collections, Anton / Hargrove / Otto / Mid-Century / Pierce & Ward, the outdoor collections and the West Elm Office collections). PARENT vs CHILD: /shop/furniture/bath-furniture/ (105) is the site's own 'All Bathroom Furniture' rollup over Vanities (87) + Bath Cabinets (17), so it became the 'Bathroom Furniture' grouping row and only the two children carry qty. /shop/furniture/benches/ (67) is an un-headered orphan node in the nav data that cuts across the emitted Bedroom Benches (48) and Dining Benches (74), so it was dropped to avoid double counting. Four nav entries pointed only at facet URLs ('Dining Cabinets', 'Bar & Kitchen Cabinets', 'Entryway Cabinets', 'Trundle Beds') and were dropped - their products are covered by Cabinets / Bar & Kitchen Furniture / Entryway Furniture / Trundles. Nursery's 'Side Tables & Nightstands' links to the same URL as Kids Bedroom > Nightstands, so it is emitted once. NAMING: sub_category values are West Elm's own mega-menu labels, so a few short names repeat across groups (Sofas, Sectionals, Coffee Tables, Dining Tables, Beds, Dressers, Nightstands, Headboards, Bookcases, Desks, Desk Chairs); each has a distinct canonical URL and the grouping row immediately above disambiguates it. West Elm Office is a genuinely separate department (the contract-grade line) with its own catalogue and its own URLs, kept as its own group.
